item.title: All Gold Skulltula locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Gold Skulltulas act as a collectible in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but they're also needed to cure a cursed family in Kakariko Village.

item.title: Anne Hathaway and JJ Abrams Sci-Fi Thriller Sets Official HBO Max Streaming Date
item.description: If you’ve been itching for a sci-fi dinosaur flick that isn’t Jurassic Park , here’s some good news: The End of Oak Street is finally coming to HBO Max, just a few short months after its run in movie theaters. The thriller from writer-director David Robert Mitchell and producer J.J. Abrams follows a suburban American family that finds itself in the prehistoric past when their entire block is inexplicably transported into the Mesozoic Era.

item.title: Netflix Officially Removes Clint Eastwood’s R-Rated War Thriller
item.description: While Clint Eastwood is often associated with the Dirty Harry franchise and Westerns such as The Good, The Bad and The Ugly , The Outlaw Josey Wales , and Unforgiven , as a director, he's frequently explored stories of war. After directing Heartbreak Ridge in 1986, Eastwood returned to war stories in a big way in the 2000s, with back-to-back World War II movies Flags of Our Fathers and Letters from Iwo Jima .

item.title: John Wick Creator’s New Action Thriller Gets First Official Trailer
item.description: John Wick creator Chad Stahelski’s next movie just got a razor-sharp first trailer. Stahelski will be producing Karoshi , an action thriller written and directed by Takashi Doscher. The film is set in a near-future Manhattan where corporations have near-total control over their employees’ lives. It will follow a mysterious outsider who infiltrates a company to expose its violent practices. As the trailer informs us, karoshi is a Japanese word for “death by overwork."

item.title: Captain's Day schedule for the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: The Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season is full of changes, including that updates to the season now come on Sundays, dubbed as "Captain's Days." These days add a new captain to the island as well as other changes you may expect from the usual Fortnite update day (like new quests and items, too).

item.title: How to complete the Treasure Chest minigame in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Treasure Chest minigame in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will test how lucky you are as you choose between two chests. As this game is all about luck, it's kind of a scam, but there's one surefire way to make it to the end and claim the prize: the Lenses of Truth . However, you're still free to try without them!

item.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Officially Fixes King Ghidorah Canon in 1 Brilliant Way
item.description: In an interview with Polygon, the film's producer, Kazuaki Kishida, wouldn't say exactly how big the budget for Godzilla Minus Zero was (though it's been confirmed to be a significantly " more " than Minus One 's $15 million), but he did reveal one way that extra money changed how Yamazaki and his team approached making the sequel.

item.title: EA Officially Brings Back 25 PC Classics With Huge Sale
item.description: Electronic Arts is not in players’ good graces right now. On Oct. 21, the publisher announced that it was closing BioWare , the beloved studio behind games like Mass Effect , Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic . The news came just a few months after EA was purchased by the Saudi Arabian government’s Public Investment Fund, Jared Kushner’s Affinity Partners, and private equity firm Silver Lake. Despite these dismal circumstances, including the fact that EA is now owned by a government responsible for numerous human rights abuses , a small group of EA developers just finished an unexpected feel-good preservation project.

item.title: New Ratchet & Clank Game Officially Cancelled by Sony
item.description: Sony 's next Ratchet & Clank game has been scrapped before receiving a full release. On Friday, Sony Interactive Entertainment and developer Oh BiBi announced Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble will be pulled from storefronts this month, and fully shut down next May.
